description: The person’s recorded rides, runs and walks: totals per sport (e-bike rides apart) over the last days (30 unless days says otherwise) and the newest ones, each with its date, distance, moving time (else the time with stops), climbing and the new lines it reached. A total counts the activities that lack a figure beside it. Read it before suggesting what to do next, so a suggestion builds on what they did.

days.description: How many days back to read, 30 when absent.

limit.description: How many to list, 20 when absent.
